card.name: Right before skin application sites
card.fires_on: Words in topical or patch instructions where the next word is likely to be skin or a body area, such as after 'transdermal system', inside 'tinea', or after 'Do not apply ... to'.

modes.label: After transdermal product names
modes.description: The word system, a closing parenthesis, or 'on' right after a patch name, before where it goes on the skin.
modes.example: Do not apply estradiol and levonorgestrel transdermal<< system>> to or near the breasts.

modes.label: Inside tinea names
modes.description: The start of 'tinea' in lists of fungal skin infections treated with creams.
modes.example: Sufficient econazole nitrate cream, 1 % should be applied to cover affected areas once daily in patients with t<<inea>> pedis, tinea cruris

modes.label: Gel strength before body parts
modes.description: A percent sign or linking word after a product name, before a body-area phrase.
